description:
Immerse Yourself in Paradise: 5BR Luxury Estate with Ocean Breeze (Santa Teresa, Costa Rica) 
              
              
                 
              
              
                 Description: 
              
              
                 
              
              
                 Escape to tranquility and unparalleled luxury at this stunning 1,000 m² (10,763 sq ft) estate in Santa Teresa, Costa Rica. Nestled amidst lush rainforest, just minutes from the pristine shores of Playa Hermosa, this property offers the perfect blend of indoor-outdoor living and a connection to the natural beauty of Costa Rica. 
              
              
                 
              
              
                 Unwind in Spacious Luxury: 
              
              
                 
              
              
                 Five spacious bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms provide ample space for family, friends, or potential rental guests. 
              
              
                 Master suite boasts a luxurious walk-in closet for ultimate convenience. 
              
              
                 Two fully-equipped kitchens cater to gourmet chefs and casual meals. 
              
              
                 Relax in the inviting living area with a bar and TV room – perfect for entertainment. 
              
              
                 Unwind and Reconnect: 
              
              
                 
              
              
                 Take a refreshing dip in the sparkling swimming pool. 
              
              
                 Invigorate your senses in the sauna and cold plunge pool. 
              
              
                 Experience the traditional Temazcal (sweat lodge) for ultimate relaxation. 
              
              
                 Find your inner peace on the dedicated yoga deck. 
              
              
                 Laundry room and two-car garage offer added convenience. 
              
              
                 Designed for Luxury: 
              
              
                 
              
              
                 Award-winning architect Manuel Cervantes masterfully crafted this stunning residence. 
              
              
                 High-quality finishes, including Chukum paint, add a touch of elegance and natural beauty. 
              
              
                 Completion expected in November 2024 - move in and start living the dream! 
              
              
                 Unbeatable Location: 
              
              
                 
              
              
                 Situated on the prestigious Avenida del Cielo in Santa Teresa, this property offers the best of both worlds: tranquility and proximity. 
              
              
                 Explore the world-renowned surfing beaches of Santa Teresa just minutes away. 
              
              
                 Immerse yourself in the vibrant community known for its wellness focus and high-end amenities. 
              
              
                 Ideal for: 
              
              
                 
              
              
                 Luxury seekers yearning for a nature-connected lifestyle. 
              
              
                 Investors looking for a lucrative vacation rental property. 
              
              
                 Families seeking a spacious and luxurious Costa Rican retreat. 
              
              
                 Contact us today to schedule a private viewing and experience paradise at this exceptional estate!
